name: hpimd-ctrl-mpa-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile hpimd_core.py hpimd_sim.py grade_hpimd.py test_hpimd_core.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_hpimd_core > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && sha256sum hpimd_core.py hpimd_sim.py grade_hpimd.py test_hpimd_core.py PREREG-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt
cd /work && python hpimd_sim.py --model mace-mpa-0 --kind ctrl --out /out --budget-s 17000 --workers 4 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^HPIMD_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 60 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
